program.step:
if data.time < state._quiet_until:
    return
blue = model.body('object_2').id
j = model.body_jntadr[blue]
q = model.jnt_qposadr[j]
x = float(data.qpos[q])
y = float(data.qpos[q + 1])
if 2.5 <= x <= 3.5 and 2.5 <= y <= 3.5:
    return
red = model.body('object_1').id
data.xfrc_applied[red, 1] += state.DRIFT * float(model.body_mass[red])
